panels.title: Usage · last 5 h
panels.description: Cost (cost_usd) per Claude account over the last 5 hours. Bar = that cost as % of the account's peak: its highest rolling 5-hour cost over the last 30 days (10-minute steps). Green below 60 %, yellow from 60 %, red from 80 %. Fixed windows: ignores the dashboard time range and the variables. Accounts with no cost in 7 days are not listed.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    concat(if(t.label = '', '(no account)', t.label), '  ·  $', toString(round(t.h5, 2))) AS name,
    round(100 * t.h5 / greatest(p.peak, t.h5, 0.000001)) AS pct
FROM
(
    SELECT account_uuid,
           argMax(account, ts) AS label,
           sumIf(cost_usd, ts >= now() - INTERVAL 5 HOUR) AS h5,
           sumIf(cost_usd, ts >= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) AS d7
    FROM cc.api_requests
    WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
    GROUP BY account_uuid
) AS t
LEFT JOIN
(
    SELECT account_uuid, max(w) AS peak
    FROM
    (
        SELECT account_uuid,
               sum(c) OVER (PARTITION BY account_uuid ORDER BY b RANGE BETWEEN 17999 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS w
        FROM
        (
            SELECT account_uuid, toUInt32(toStartOfInterval(ts, INTERVAL 10 MINUTE)) AS b, sum(cost_usd) AS c
            FROM cc.api_requests
            WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
            GROUP BY account_uuid, b
        )
    )
    GROUP BY account_uuid
) AS p ON p.account_uuid = t.account_uuid
WHERE t.d7 > 0
ORDER BY t.h5 DESC, t.d7 DESC

panels.title: Tips · 7 d
panels.description: Number of tips (view cc.tips, last 7 days). Click the value to open the Tips section of the Efficiency dashboard. Ignores the dashboard time range and the variables.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count() AS tips
FROM cc.tips

panels.description: The most frequent tip category (view cc.tips, last 7 days) with its count in brackets (ties: alphabetical order). Click the value to open the Tips section of the Efficiency dashboard. Ignores the dashboard time range and the variables.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT if(tips = 0, 'none', concat(multiIf(top = 'cache', 'Cache rebuilds', top = 'repeated-read', 'Repeated reads', top = 'big-results', 'Big tool results', top = 'short-opus', 'Short Opus answers', top = 'agent-outlier', 'Costly agent run', top = 'denials', 'Denied tool calls', top = 'slow-hook', 'Slow hooks', top = 'slow-ttft', 'Slow first token', top), ' (', toString(n), ')')) AS most_frequent
FROM
(
    SELECT sum(c) AS tips,
           argMin(category, (-toInt64(c), category)) AS top,
           max(c) AS n
    FROM (SELECT category, count() AS c FROM cc.tips GROUP BY category)
)

panels.title: Actor = main agent or a subagent type. Skill cost = cost_usd of the turns after the skill was invoked.
panels.description: Every panel follows the time range and the Account, Project, Session, Actor and Skill variables. The rail on the left ignores them.

panels.title: Subagent share
panels.description: Share of cost_usd spent by subagents: sum of cost_usd of the model requests with an agent_id divided by the cost_usd of all requests (main session and auxiliary requests included). cost_usd is computed by Claude Code from API prices: on a subscription it is not a bill.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 100 * sumIf(cost_usd, agent_id != '') / greatest(sum(cost_usd), 0.000001) AS share, 'of cost_usd' AS name
FROM cc.api_requests WHERE ('__all' IN (${account:singlequote}) OR account_uuid IN (${account:singlequote})) AND ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}') AND $__timeFilter(ts)

panels.title: Subagent runs
panels.description: Completed subagent runs (subagent_completed events) and the number of agent types among them. The Actor variable matches the agent type; the Skill variable keeps the runs whose model requests carried that skill.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count() AS runs, concat(toString(uniqExact(agent_type)), if(uniqExact(agent_type) = 1, ' type', ' types')) AS name
FROM cc.events WHERE event = 'subagent_completed' AND agent_type != '' AND ('__all' IN (${account:singlequote}) OR account_uuid IN (${account:singlequote})) AND ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR agent_type = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR agent_id IN (SELECT agent_id FROM cc.events_raw WHERE '${skill}' != '__all' AND skill_name = '${skill}' AND agent_id != '')) AND $__timeFilter(ts)

panels.title: Skills used
panels.description: Distinct skills activated (skill_activated events) and the number of activations. Claude Code reports skill activations of the main session only, so with an agent selected as Actor this shows 0.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT uniqExact(skill_name) AS skills, concat(toString(count()), if(count() = 1, ' invocation', ' invocations')) AS name
FROM cc.events WHERE event = 'skill_activated' AND skill_name != '' AND ('__all' IN (${account:singlequote}) OR account_uuid IN (${account:singlequote})) AND ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR (agent_id = '' AND '${actor}' = 'main')) AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill_name = '${skill}') AND $__timeFilter(ts)

panels.title: Outlier runs
panels.description: Subagent runs whose tokens (total_tokens of subagent_completed) are above 6 times the mean of their agent type and above 50k: the rule of the agent-outlier tip, but over the time range and the variables instead of the last 7 days. Green with none, yellow with one or more.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT countIf(agent_total_tokens > 6 * mean_tokens AND agent_total_tokens > 50000) AS outliers, '> 6× type mean and > 50k tokens' AS name
FROM
(
    SELECT agent_total_tokens, avg(agent_total_tokens) OVER (PARTITION BY agent_type) AS mean_tokens
    FROM cc.events WHERE event = 'subagent_completed' AND agent_type != '' AND ('__all' IN (${account:singlequote}) OR account_uuid IN (${account:singlequote})) AND ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR agent_type = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR agent_id IN (SELECT agent_id FROM cc.events_raw WHERE '${skill}' != '__all' AND skill_name = '${skill}' AND agent_id != '')) AND $__timeFilter(ts)
)

panels.title: Subagent types · click a type to filter by it
panels.description: Completed subagent runs per agent type: runs, mean and maximum tokens of one run (total_tokens of subagent_completed), Max/mean (above 4 yellow, above 6 red; the agent-outlier tip also needs a run above 50k tokens) and cost_usd of the type's model requests. Sorted by cost_usd. A click filters the dashboard by that type (Actor variable).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT t.agent_type AS type, t.runs AS runs, t.mean_tokens AS mean_tokens, t.max_tokens AS max_tokens,
       t.max_tokens / greatest(t.mean_tokens, 1) AS ratio, ifNull(c.cost, 0) AS cost_usd
FROM
(
    SELECT agent_type, count() AS runs, avg(agent_total_tokens) AS mean_tokens, max(agent_total_tokens) AS max_tokens
    FROM cc.events WHERE event = 'subagent_completed' AND agent_type != '' AND ('__all' IN (${account:singlequote}) OR account_uuid IN (${account:singlequote})) AND ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR agent_type = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR agent_id IN (SELECT agent_id FROM cc.events_raw WHERE '${skill}' != '__all' AND skill_name = '${skill}' AND agent_id != '')) AND $__timeFilter(ts)
    GROUP BY agent_type
) AS t
LEFT JOIN
(
    SELECT actor, sum(cost_usd) AS cost
    FROM cc.api_requests WHERE ('__all' IN (${account:singlequote}) OR account_uuid IN (${account:singlequote})) AND ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}') AND $__timeFilter(ts) AND agent_id != ''
    GROUP BY actor
) AS c ON c.actor = t.agent_type
ORDER BY cost_usd DESC, runs DESC

panels.title: cost_usd per day by actor
panels.description: cost_usd of the model requests per day: subagents (requests with an agent_id) and main (the main session and auxiliary requests). Days are in server time (UTC).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toStartOfDay(ts) AS time, sumIf(cost_usd, agent_id = '') AS main, sumIf(cost_usd, agent_id != '') AS subagents
FROM cc.api_requests WHERE ('__all' IN (${account:singlequote}) OR account_uuid IN (${account:singlequote})) AND ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}') AND $__timeFilter(ts)
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Skills · click a skill to filter by it
panels.description: Per skill: activations (skill_activated events), sessions and projects they happened in, and cost_usd of the model requests that carried the skill (the turns after it was invoked, until the end of the prompt). Sorted by cost_usd. A click filters the dashboard by that skill (Skill variable).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT s.skill AS skill, s.uses AS uses, s.sessions AS sessions, s.projects AS projects, ifNull(t.cost, 0) AS cost_usd
FROM
(
    SELECT skill_name AS skill, count() AS uses, uniqExact(session_id) AS sessions, uniqExact(project) AS projects
    FROM cc.events WHERE event = 'skill_activated' AND skill_name != '' AND ('__all' IN (${account:singlequote}) OR account_uuid IN (${account:singlequote})) AND ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR (agent_id = '' AND '${actor}' = 'main')) AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill_name = '${skill}') AND $__timeFilter(ts)
    GROUP BY skill
) AS s
LEFT JOIN
(
    SELECT skill, sum(cost_usd) AS cost
    FROM cc.api_requests WHERE ('__all' IN (${account:singlequote}) OR account_uuid IN (${account:singlequote})) AND ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}') AND $__timeFilter(ts) AND skill != ''
    GROUP BY skill
) AS t ON t.skill = s.skill
ORDER BY cost_usd DESC, uses DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Biggest subagent runs · click a session to open it
panels.description: The 5 completed subagent runs with the most tokens (total_tokens of subagent_completed) in the time range; cost_usd = the model requests of that run. Outlier (red) marks a run above 6 times the mean of its type and above 50k tokens, the Outlier runs rule. A click opens the run's session on Sessions and zooms the time range to it (3 % padding, at least 5 seconds).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT r.session_id AS sid,
       if(w.t1 = 0, r.ms, w.t0) - greatest(intDiv(3 * (if(w.t1 = 0, r.ms, w.t1) - if(w.t1 = 0, r.ms, w.t0)), 100), 5000) AS from_ms,
       if(w.t1 = 0, r.ms, w.t1) + greatest(intDiv(3 * (if(w.t1 = 0, r.ms, w.t1) - if(w.t1 = 0, r.ms, w.t0)), 100), 5000) AS to_ms,
       left(r.session_id, 8) AS session, r.agent_type AS type, r.agent_total_tokens AS tokens,
       if(r.agent_total_tokens > 6 * r.mean_tokens AND r.agent_total_tokens > 50000, concat(toString(round(r.agent_total_tokens / r.mean_tokens, 1)), '× mean'), '') AS outlier,
       ifNull(c.cost, 0) AS cost_usd
FROM
(
    SELECT session_id, agent_id, agent_type, agent_total_tokens, toUnixTimestamp64Milli(ts) AS ms,
           avg(agent_total_tokens) OVER (PARTITION BY agent_type) AS mean_tokens
    FROM cc.events WHERE event = 'subagent_completed' AND agent_type != '' AND ('__all' IN (${account:singlequote}) OR account_uuid IN (${account:singlequote})) AND ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR agent_type = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR agent_id IN (SELECT agent_id FROM cc.events_raw WHERE '${skill}' != '__all' AND skill_name = '${skill}' AND agent_id != '')) AND $__timeFilter(ts)
    ORDER BY agent_total_tokens DESC LIMIT 5
) AS r
LEFT JOIN
(
    SELECT agent_id, sum(cost_usd) AS cost
    FROM cc.api_requests WHERE ('__all' IN (${account:singlequote}) OR account_uuid IN (${account:singlequote})) AND ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND $__timeFilter(ts) AND agent_id != ''
    GROUP BY agent_id
) AS c ON c.agent_id = r.agent_id
LEFT JOIN
(
    SELECT session_id, min(a_s) AS t0, max(a_e) AS t1
    FROM
    (
        SELECT session_id, toUnixTimestamp64Milli(ts) - if(event = 'user_prompt', toInt64(0), toInt64(duration_ms)) AS a_s, toUnixTimestamp64Milli(ts) AS a_e
        FROM cc.events_raw
        WHERE event IN ('user_prompt', 'api_request', 'tool_result')
          AND session_id IN (SELECT session_id FROM cc.events_raw WHERE event = 'subagent_completed' AND $__timeFilter(ts))
    )
    GROUP BY session_id
) AS w ON w.session_id = r.session_id
ORDER BY r.agent_total_tokens DESC
